items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: But Bill Claw owned the hotel

ctx.x: -- so then you mean in the -- the -- a lot of the people the musicians came in contact with then in terms of hotels were hustler -- hustling people.

Yes, most of them in the Vendome. But Bill Claw owned the hotel, had another brother who was the biggest -- big number man in Buffalo -- by the name of Joe Claw, big lanky, and another brother by the name of George Claw. He lived in the Vendome. Joe Claw lived out in north Buffalo or somewhere up there. I never got too close to Joe, not that I didn't want to, just never happened. George Claw I knew well because he was just a commoner.
Well, tell -- now, you had -- when you all, when you all were off work like -- did the band -- did the band rehearse much?
